scope: Original native VBScript evaluates each program and emits its counter. Names are prefixed only to isolate cases. No clock, RNG, body or render-state overrides.

cases.name: inline collection handler
cases.source:
Dim Count:Count=0
Sub Mark()
Count=Count+1
End Sub
Sub Handler(idx):Mark:End Sub
Handler 4

cases.name: call followed by assignment
cases.source:
Dim Count:Count=0
Sub Mark()
Count=Count+1
End Sub
Mark:Count=Count+10

cases.name: single-line conditional
cases.body: If True Then Mark:Count=Count+10 Else Count=100
cases.source:
Dim Count:Count=0
Sub Mark()
Count=Count+1
End Sub
If True Then Mark:Count=Count+10 Else Count=100

cases.name: colon-separated loop
cases.source:
Dim Count:Count=0
Sub Mark()
Count=Count+1
End Sub
Dim idx
For idx=1 To 3:Mark:Next

cases.name: literal and comment colons
cases.source:
Dim Count:Count=0
Sub Mark()
Count=Count+1
End Sub
Dim text
text="Mark:":' Mark:
Mark:Count=Count+10

cases.name: discarded function result
cases.body:
Function Value()
Count=Count+1:Value=42
End Function
Value:Count=Count+10
